# Sieve API contract

This file is generated from `sieve/protocol` and the assembled router.
Every description below is a godoc comment or a `doc:"…"` struct tag read out of
the source, so the way to change this document is to change the declaration it

Package protocol is the single source of truth for Sieve's wire contract: the frames of the two WebSocket channels (document and workspace) and the typed bodies of the JSON endpoints.

Channel names a WebSocket wire.

### `workspace` — `/api/ws/workspace`

**Client → server**

| Type | Payload | Correlated on | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `protocol.CommandFrame` | `correlationId` | CommandFrame dispatches one slash command. |
| `command-cancel` | `protocol.CommandCancelFrame` | `correlationId` | CommandCancelFrame cancels an in-flight command by its correlation id. |
| `mention-query` | `protocol.MentionQueryFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionQueryFrame is the `@`-picker's typeahead question. |
| `mention-resolve` | `protocol.MentionResolveFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionResolveFrame asks where a coordinate opens. |
| `ping` | `protocol.PingFrame` | — | PingFrame is a liveness probe, answered with a PongFrame. |
| `session-scroll` | `protocol.SessionScrollFrame` | — | SessionScrollFrame persists one tab's scroll offset — the per-user VIEW coordinate a surface debounces up while the user scrolls, plus the pull at tab deactivation. |

**Server → client**

| Type | Payload | Correlated on | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command-result` | `protocol.CommandResultFrame` | `correlationId` | CommandResultFrame reports one step of a command's lifecycle. |
| `container-deleted` | `protocol.ContainerDeletedFrame` | — | ContainerDeletedFrame is NEWS, not an instruction: the container it names is already gone from the store, and every workspace socket hears so. |
| `container-saved` | `protocol.ContainerSavedFrame` | — | ContainerSavedFrame is NEWS in the same past tense its deleted sibling carries: the container it names has just reached disk, and every workspace socket hears so. |
| `invalidate` | `protocol.InvalidateFrame` | — | InvalidateFrame tells every connected workspace socket that a subject changed and the views showing it are stale. |
| `jobs-changed` | `protocol.JobsChangedFrame` | — | JobsChangedFrame broadcasts the whole job snapshot whenever it changes. |
| `mention-resolved` | `protocol.MentionResolvedFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionResolvedFrame answers "where does this coordinate open" with something the client can ACT on — a document to open, a block to reveal — and never anything it would have to parse. |
| `mention-result` | `protocol.MentionResultFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionResultFrame answers a typeahead. |
| `pong` | `protocol.PongFrame` | — | PongFrame answers a PingFrame. |

## Invalidation topics

Topic is what an invalidate frame invalidates — the subject a view refetches when it hears one.

| Topic | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `notes` | the note/folder tree changed |
| `session` | tabs, active tab, or panel state changed |
| `prompts` | the prompt library changed |
| `library` | the open library changed |
| `intent` | a document's user_intent changed |

## Frame reference

### `document` channel

#### `block-op` — client → server

BlockOpFrame applies one granular operation to the authoritative block tree.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the block-op-ack; absent means no ack is sent |
| `op` | `block.BlockOp` | yes |  |

#### `detect-extractions` — client → server

DetectExtractionsFrame asks which blocks a selection could become — the offer list behind the extract menu.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the detect-extractions-result reply |
| `sourceKind` | `string` | yes | the kind the selection came from; shapes which offers make sense |
| `entries` | `[]block.ContentEntry` | yes | the selection, one entry per clipboard-style view |

#### `doc-update` — client → server

DocUpdateFrame carries the markdown-mode buffer's current text to the shadow document.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `markdown` | `string` | yes | the whole buffer, not a diff |

#### `enter-markdown` — client → server

EnterMarkdownFrame switches the document to markdown mode: the server embeds the current block state into markdown and answers with a MarkdownContentFrame carrying the merged text to seed the markdown editor.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the markdown-content reply |

#### `enter-wysiwyg` — client → server

EnterWysiwygFrame switches the document to WYSIWYG mode, re-parsing the block tree from the markdown the client holds and answering with a WysiwygContentFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `markdown` | `*string` | no | the buffer to re-parse; absent means keep what the shadow holds |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the wysiwyg-content reply |

#### `export` — client → server

ExportFrame asks for clean whole-document text — the "Copy as Markdown" contract, with AI blocks excluded because prior Q&A is conversation, not document content.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the export-content reply |
| `format` | `string` | no | markdown, the only format there is |

#### `extract` — client → server

ExtractFrame creates a block from selected content — the additive extract/paste mechanic and the in-place transform, told apart by Operation.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the extract-ack |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes | the source block: transformed in place, or extracted from |
| `targetKind` | `string` | yes | the block kind to create |
| `operation` | `block.Action` | no | empty means extract — the additive default |
| `entries` | `[]block.ContentEntry` | yes | the selection, one entry per clipboard-style view |
| `index` | `int` | yes | document position for the new block; -1 appends, and is the default when the key is absent |

#### `flush` — client → server

FlushFrame asks the shadow document to persist now rather than on its debounce.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `focus` — client → server

FocusFrame is the dwell ping: the user is looking at this document, which raises its focus count.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `load` — client → server

LoadFrame asks for the document this channel is bound to, as the editor mounts it.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the load-content reply |

#### `paste` — client → server

PasteFrame hands a clipboard to the server to make sense of.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the paste-ack |
| `kind` | `protocol.PasteKind` | yes | smart \| slice \| native-drop \| native-clipboard. SECURITY: native-drop and native-clipboard make the server read files the NATIVE side caught (the drop bucket) or the OS clipboard names — never paths from the wire, so the wire carries the GESTURE, not a filesystem address. The socket upgrade's origin allow-list keeps foreign pages from sending these; auth-on-upgrade (#83) must cover this channel. |
| `entries` | `[]block.ContentEntry` | no | smart: the clipboard's views. native-drop: absent — the server takes the paths from the native drop bucket the OS-level catch fed (Wails OnFileDrop); the page's own view of a drop is never consulted. native-clipboard: absent — the server reads the clipboard itself |
| `slice` | `[][]block.ContentEntry` | no | slice only: one view set per copied block, in order |
| `index` | `int` | yes | document position for the first created block; -1 appends, and is the default when the key is absent |

#### `ping` — client → server

PingFrame is a liveness probe, answered with a PongFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `retry-block-job` — client → server

RetryBlockJobFrame re-runs the job of one block that failed or was interrupted.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | the block whose job re-runs |

#### `block-attrs-updated` — server → client

BlockAttrsUpdatedFrame is the render-back for a block whose attrs the server changed — a finished job's result, a status transition.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | yes | the full attrs bag, not a patch |

#### `block-op-ack` — server → client

AckFrame is the request-correlated outcome of a block-op or an extract.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `ok` | `bool` | yes |  |
| `error` | `string` | no | present only when ok is false |

#### `detect-extractions-result` — server → client

DetectExtractionsResultFrame is one offer per kind that would accept the selection.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `offers` | `[]block.SupportedActions` | yes | never null — the menu renders a list, and an empty one means nothing claimed the selection |

#### `error` — server → client

ErrorFrame reports that an operation failed, in words meant for the user.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `message` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `export-content` — server → client

ExportContentFrame carries the exported document.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `format` | `string` | yes | the format that was produced, echoed — it decides the clipboard's mime type |
| `content` | `string` | yes | the whole exported document |

#### `extract-ack` — server → client

AckFrame is the request-correlated outcome of a block-op or an extract.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `ok` | `bool` | yes |  |
| `error` | `string` | no | present only when ok is false |

#### `insert-block` — server → client

InsertBlockFrame is the render-back for a block the SERVER created: the client places this authoritative node at this index as a tracked transaction, and never computes a position of its own.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | yes |  |
| `index` | `int` | yes | document position to insert at |
| `markdown` | `string` | yes | markdown-mode buffer only; WYSIWYG renders from attrs |
| `token` | `string` | yes | transient handle echoed from a create-block op, so the client can swap its pending node for the authoritative id |

#### `load-content` — server → client

LoadContentFrame answers a load.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `body` | `string` | yes | raw markdown, frontmatter already stripped |
| `mode` | `string` | yes | wysiwyg \| markdown — the mode this document was last in |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | empty when nothing was found, which the client treats as an empty document |
| `scroll` | `int` | yes | the tab's saved scroll offset; 0 parks at the top |
| `version` | `int` | yes | the version of the content served here; 0 when the container keeps no version history |
| `blocks` | `[]block.FrontendBlock` | no | WYSIWYG only: the block list, already through the shadow so ids are stable |
| `opId` | `string` | no |  |

#### `markdown-content` — server → client

MarkdownContentFrame is the merged markdown that seeds the markdown editor after a mode switch.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes |  |
| `markdown` | `string` | yes | blocks embedded back into markdown — the whole document |
| `opId` | `string` | no |  |

#### `paste-ack` — server → client

PasteAckFrame answers a paste with what the server made of the clipboard.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `outcome` | `block.PasteOutcome` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | no |  |
| `id` | `string` | no |  |
| `rawYaml` | `string` | no |  |
| `html` | `string` | no |  |
| `error` | `string` | no | why the paste failed; the outcome is then none, so the client still replays locally |

#### `pong` — server → client

PongFrame answers a PingFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `replace-block` — server → client

ReplaceBlockFrame is the render-back for an in-place transform: one block becomes another kind with a new identity, and the client replaces by id rather than reloading the document.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `oldId` | `string` | yes | the block being replaced; the client matches on it rather than reloading |
| `newKind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `newId` | `string` | yes | a transform mints a fresh identity — the new block is not the old one renamed |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | yes | the new block's full attrs bag |
| `newYaml` | `string` | yes | markdown-mode buffer only |

#### `wysiwyg-content` — server → client

WysiwygContentFrame is the re-parsed block list the WYSIWYG editor mounts after a mode switch.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes |  |
| `blocks` | `[]block.FrontendBlock` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no |  |

### `workspace` channel

#### `command` — client → server

CommandFrame dispatches one slash command.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `family` | `string` | no | the family the caller believes this command belongs to; empty skips the check |
| `cmd` | `string` | yes | the verb, without its slash |
| `args` | `protocol.CommandArgs` | yes |  |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes | required — a command with no correlation id is dropped, because its result could not be routed |
| `context` | `json.RawMessage` | no | whatever the invoking surface knows about the selection, shaped by that surface |
| `attachments` | `[]domain.Attachment` | no | coordinates the composer attached with @; what a command does with them is its own business |

#### `command-cancel` — client → server

CommandCancelFrame cancels an in-flight command by its correlation id.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `mention-query` — client → server

MentionQueryFrame is the `@`-picker's typeahead question.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `q` | `string` | yes | the partial the user has typed |
| `limit` | `int` | no | how many candidates to return; the server floors and caps it |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `mention-resolve` — client → server

MentionResolveFrame asks where a coordinate opens.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `uri` | `string` | yes | a domain.Address coordinate: container:{uuid}[@v{n}], block:{uuid}, block:{container}[@v{n}]/{handle} |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `ping` — client → server

PingFrame is a liveness probe, answered with a PongFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `session-scroll` — client → server

SessionScrollFrame persists one tab's scroll offset — the per-user VIEW coordinate a surface debounces up while the user scrolls, plus the pull at tab deactivation.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | the tab whose offset this is |
| `scroll` | `int` | yes | the pixel offset from the top |

#### `command-result` — server → client

CommandResultFrame reports one step of a command's lifecycle.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `cmd` | `string` | yes |  |
| `status` | `string` | yes | PENDING \| COMPLETE \| ERROR |
| `block` | `*protocol.CommandResultBlock` | no | present when this step produced a block to render |
| `error` | `string` | no | present on ERROR |

#### `container-deleted` — server → client

ContainerDeletedFrame is NEWS, not an instruction: the container it names is already gone from the store, and every workspace socket hears so.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the container that no longer exists |

#### `container-saved` — server → client

ContainerSavedFrame is NEWS in the same past tense its deleted sibling carries: the container it names has just reached disk, and every workspace socket hears so.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the container whose content just reached disk |
| `version` | `int` | yes | the document version this save produced; 0 when the container keeps no version history |

#### `invalidate` — server → client

InvalidateFrame tells every connected workspace socket that a subject changed and the views showing it are stale.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `topic` | `protocol.Topic` | yes |  |

JobsChangedFrame broadcasts the whole job snapshot whenever it changes.

| `queued` | `[]domain.JobInfo` | yes | jobs waiting for a worker; never null |

#### `mention-resolved` — server → client

MentionResolvedFrame answers "where does this coordinate open" with something the client can ACT on — a document to open, a block to reveal — and never anything it would have to parse.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `uri` | `string` | yes | the coordinate that was asked about, echoed |
| `found` | `bool` | yes |  |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the container to open |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes | the block to reveal inside it; empty for a whole container |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | the target's own noun, e.g. note |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `error` | `string` | no | why it did not resolve |

#### `mention-result` — server → client

MentionResultFrame answers a typeahead.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `candidates` | `[]domain.Candidate` | yes | never null — the picker renders a list, and an empty one means no matches |

#### `pong` — server → client

PongFrame answers a PingFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

## Typed HTTP endpoints

An endpoint appears here when its contract is typed data in either direction.
Everything else the app serves is hypermedia or bytes, and appears in the route
inventory below instead.

| Operation | Response | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/document/load` | json | DocumentLoadRequest reads a channel-less pseudo-document's content. |
| `POST /api/document/save` | json | DocumentSaveRequest writes a document's buffer to disk. |
| `POST /api/folder` | fragment | FolderCreateRequest makes a new folder. |
| `PATCH /api/folder/{id}` | fragment | FolderPatchRequest changes a folder's properties. |
| `PATCH /api/note/{id}` | fragment | NotePatchRequest changes a note's properties. |
| `POST /api/tabs/close` | fragment | TabsCloseRequest closes every listed tab — the ONE close mechanism. |

### `GET /api/document/load`

**Request** — `protocol.DocumentLoadRequest`

DocumentLoadRequest reads a channel-less pseudo-document's content.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the prompt pseudo-document id (prompt:{name}); a query parameter, not a body field |

**Response** — `protocol.DocumentContent`

DocumentContent is a document as the editor mounts it: the buffer, the mode it was last in, and — in WYSIWYG — the block list it renders from.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | `string` | yes | raw markdown, frontmatter already stripped |
| `mode` | `string` | yes | wysiwyg \| markdown — the mode this document was last in |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | empty when nothing was found, which the client treats as an empty document |
| `scroll` | `int` | yes | the tab's saved scroll offset; 0 parks at the top |
| `version` | `int` | yes | the version of the content served here; 0 when the container keeps no version history |
| `blocks` | `[]block.FrontendBlock` | no | WYSIWYG only: the block list, already through the shadow so ids are stable |

### `POST /api/document/save`

**Request** — `protocol.DocumentSaveRequest`

DocumentSaveRequest writes a document's buffer to disk.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the prompt pseudo-document id (prompt:{name}); a query parameter, not a body field |
| `body` | `string` | yes | the whole buffer |
| `mode` | `string` | no | records which mode saved it; empty leaves the recorded mode alone |

**Response** — `protocol.DocumentSaveResponse`

DocumentSaveResponse reports the version the save produced.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `int` | yes | the saved document's new version number; 0 for a container that keeps no version history |

### `POST /api/folder`

**Request** — `protocol.FolderCreateRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

FolderCreateRequest makes a new folder.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

### `PATCH /api/folder/{id}`

Path parameters: `id`

**Request** — `protocol.FolderPatchRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

FolderPatchRequest changes a folder's properties.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `*string` | no | the new display name; absent leaves it alone |
| `open` | `*bool` | no | whether the folder is expanded in the tree; absent leaves it alone |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

### `PATCH /api/note/{id}`

Path parameters: `id`

**Request** — `protocol.NotePatchRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

NotePatchRequest changes a note's properties.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | the new display name |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

### `POST /api/tabs/close`

**Request** — `protocol.TabsCloseRequest`

TabsCloseRequest closes every listed tab — the ONE close mechanism.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | `[]string` | yes | the tabs to close |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

## Payload types

Types a frame or an endpoint carries inside its envelope. Each is described on
its own declaration, in the package that owns it.

### `block.Action`

Action is an operation a processor can perform on a set of ContentEntry views.

### `block.BlockOp`

BlockOp is a granular mutation of the BlockDoc tree, carried over the wire (Stage C, spec §4).

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | no |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | no |  |
| `aliases` | `[]string` | no |  |
| `index` | `int` | yes |  |
| `parentId` | `string` | no |  |
| `token` | `string` | no |  |
| `order` | `[]string` | no | set-order only: the complete top-level block id order to install |

### `block.ContentEntry`

ContentEntry is one item from the browser clipboard DataTransfer.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mimeType` | `string` | yes |  |
| `content` | `string` | yes |  |
| `context` | `map[string]interface {}` | no |  |

### `block.FrontendBlock`

FrontendBlock is the wire shape the WYSIWYG editor renders from (Stage D.2).

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | no |  |
| `aliases` | `[]string` | no |  |

### `block.PasteOutcome`

PasteOutcome discriminates what a paste round-trip actually did.

### `block.PasteResult`

PasteResult is what one paste did — a discriminated union, not a bag of optional flags.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | `block.PasteOutcome` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | no |  |
| `id` | `string` | no |  |
| `rawYaml` | `string` | no |  |
| `html` | `string` | no |  |

### `block.SupportedActions`

SupportedActions is one processor's offer for a set of entries: its Kind plus the operations it supports.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `actions` | `[]block.Action` | yes |  |

### `domain.Attachment`

Attachment is a live edge to another Node in the system: the address of something Sieve already holds, offered as context for one AI turn.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uri` | `string` | yes |  |
| `title` | `string` | no |  |

### `domain.Candidate`

Candidate is one offer from a source's enumeration face: what the picker shows and what an accepted mention persists.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uri` | `string` | yes |  |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `detail` | `string` | yes |  |

### `domain.JobInfo`

JobInfo describes one background job the UI can see: what the tab spinner and the jobs view render, and what the workspace wire's jobs-changed frame carries.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` | yes |  |
| `docId` | `string` | no |  |
| `spinTab` | `bool` | yes |  |
| `state` | `string` | no |  |
| `category` | `string` | no |  |

### `protocol.CommandArgs`

CommandArgs is what the user typed after the verb.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | yes |  |

### `protocol.CommandResultBlock`

CommandResultBlock is the block a command produced, projected to what the client renders it from.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | yes |  |

### `protocol.JobsSnapshot`

JobsSnapshot is every job the UI can see, in insertion order.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | `[]domain.JobInfo` | yes | jobs a worker is running now; never null |
| `queued` | `[]domain.JobInfo` | yes | jobs waiting for a worker; never null |

### `protocol.PasteKind`

PasteKind discriminates what a paste is asking for.

### `protocol.Topic`

Topic is what an invalidate frame invalidates — the subject a view refetches when it hears one.

## Command words

Every registered verb. They ride the workspace wire's `command` frame as DATA —
a new command is not a new frame type — and are listed because a client has to
spell both the verb and the family it is invoked within: the dispatcher rejects
a verb sent under a family that is not its own.

| Family | Command | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `ai` | `/btw` | Quick answer in a popup — nothing is added to the document |
| `ai` | `/file` | File this document where the AI's evaluation says it belongs |
| `ai` | `/keep-and-file` | Mark this document as kept, then file it |
| `ai` | `/metadata` | Re-evaluate this document's title, summary and tags |
| `ai` | `/summary` | 3-bullet summary of document or selection |
| `ai` | `/todo` | Extract open action items, TODOs, and decisions as a checklist |
| `util` | `/base64` | Base64 encode/decode inline text, selection, or document |
| `util` | `/env` | Go runtime info: OS, arch, CPUs, goroutines, memory |
| `util` | `/hash` | SHA-256 hash of inline text, selection, or document |
| `util` | `/jwt` | Decode & inspect a JWT header + payload (no signature verification) |
| `util` | `/migrate-ids` | Upgrade every document's block ids to UUIDs so blocks are addressable |
| `util` | `/now` | Display current timestamp & date in all standard formats |
| `util` | `/stats` | Word count, character count, reading time & document metrics |
| `util` | `/uuid` | Generate a new random UUID v4 |

## Route inventory

Every route the app mounts, walked off the assembled router. `/ui/*` is safe,
idempotent views and bytes; `/api/*` is operations and protocols. A route whose
contract is typed data is described above; the rest serve hypermedia, bytes,
or another protocol's own transport.
